<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Emit Defensive Odor](/Feats.aspx?ID=5278) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
<trait label="Inhaled" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=634" />
<trait label="Poison" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=669" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 19

**Frequency**
once per day

</column>

---

While athamarus' natural pheromones are typically used for communication, you have developed yours into a defense mechanism to ward off foes. You emit a thick spray of defensive pheromones at an adjacent creature, who takes 2d6 poison damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save against your class DC.

 At 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.

<title level="2">Emit Defensive Odor leads to...</title>
[Noxious Odor](/Feats.aspx?ID=5283), [Offensive Odor](/Feats.aspx?ID=5296), [Persistent Odor](/Feats.aspx?ID=5289), [Rapid Pheromone Recovery](/Feats.aspx?ID=5292)
name: Emit Defensive Odor
